name: Heart Problems
source:
In Heart problems you control Iker, who lives with his uncle and his family (your aunt-in-law and their daughters). His mother left him with them at age 12 with no apparent explanation and since then he has not heard from her.
He has just arrived home after a semester at college and from here the story unfolds.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/xenorav]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《心脏问题》中，你控制伊克尔，他与他的叔叔和家人（你的姑姑和他们的女儿）住在一起。他的母亲在他12岁时把他留给了他们，没有任何明显的解释，从那以后他就再也没有收到过她的消息。
他在大学学习了一个学期后刚刚回到家，故事就从这里展开。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/xenorav]Patreon[/url]]
